purpose.description: Accepted values after trimming and case normalization: REPORT_PHOTO, BEFORE, AFTER, MEASUREMENT, SURVEY_VIDEO, TELEMETRY, ROUTE_SOURCE, DOCUMENT.

sizeBytes.description: Global admitted union bound8GiB. Conditional: photos20MiB,video8GiB,telemetry10MiB,DOCUMENT/ROUTE_SOURCE int.MaxValue. Not every purpose can use the global maximum.

AiServiceBearer.description: Dedicated RS256 AI callback JWT: issuer roadguard-backend, audience roadguard-ai-callback, separate kid/keyring, TTL 300 seconds, jobId/attemptId binding. Human JWTs are rejected.

WebSession.description: Browser-managed Secure HttpOnly session cookie, obtained by web login. Swagger Authorize cannot set HttpOnly cookies.
WebSession.name: __Host-RoadGuardSession

WebRenewal.description: Browser-managed protected renewal cookie, obtained by web login; do not copy or expose it.
WebRenewal.name: __Host-RoadGuardRenewal

AntiforgeryCookie.description: Browser-managed antiforgery cookie from GET /api/v1/auth/web/csrf; paired with X-CSRF-TOKEN.
AntiforgeryCookie.name: __Host-RoadGuardCsrf

CsrfToken.description: Copy the actual requestToken from GET /api/v1/auth/web/csrf in the same browser. Required for cookie-authenticated unsafe requests.
CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
